question: Do either canonical 256-byte grid payload, expanded by four pinned PRFs, pass the source's English-score screen at the simplest key alignment?
target: First 400 runes of the pinned 12,956-rune unsolved LP2 transcription
decoder: Pinned skip-aware beam, width 120, maximum 3 key skips; source English quadgram scorer
control: Run pinned B-05 planted test for all four named generators before interpreting any negative screen
null: Pinned 200 shuffled 400-rune heads, source seed 3301 and rotating offsets
acceptance: Normalized English score >= -5.5 and greater than the maximum shuffle-null score
interpretation: A finite negative screen on 32 source-defined cases, not a full-page decryption test or rejection of the payload-derived-key family
